title.narrative: Medium-Voltage Sub-Transmission Expansion Sector Project (former name: Rural Electrification Project)

description.narrative: The proposed project will expand the supply of reliable and cost effective grid-electricity in Kampong Thom, Kampong Cham, Siem Reap, Kandal and Banteay Meanchey province in Cambodia. It will (i) expand the electricity transmission infrastructure by constructing 2,110 kilometer (km) of 22 kilovolt (kV) sub-transmission lines , (ii) support the implementation of the project, and (iii) improve the operational effectiveness and efficiency of Electricite du Cambodge.

Status of Implementation Progress: Component 1:
22kV sub-transmission lines expanded by 2,387 cct-km across Kampong Thom, Kampong Cham, Siem Reap, Kandal, and Banteay Meanchey provinces.
Component 2:
Implementation of subprojects being supported by Project Implementation Consultant; technical designs, bidding documents and contracts completed; compensation payments completed.
Component 3:
All financial covenants complied with; EDC has stronger operational and financial capacity; financial accounting and enterprise public utility organization management information system rolled out being implemented; gender-balanced human resource management and development being implemented.
